limitations: Requires pairwise-distinct positive couplings for the deterministic classification and iid atomless positive couplings for probabilistic universality. No claim for time-dependent physical quench distributions, annealed count rates, or growing-budget CLTs.
scientific_integrity: Exact deterministic theorem with analytic probability and finite-dependence fluctuation argument; finite verification checks are supportive only.
title: Universal cooperative metastability entropy and fluctuations in random ferromagnetic chains
